## Preplanning Considerations (from Risk & Scope Scan)

- [Testing] Story B's novelty gate depends on Story A's proximity matcher — ensure tests cover the full call chain: relation extraction → proximity check → auto-downgrade → relation-distribution logging. Do not stub Story A's matcher in Story B's tests.
- [Reliability] LLM non-compliance monitoring: if > 80% of findings auto-downgrade across 2-3 cycles after shipping, treat as prompt-compliance regression and escalate. Add a test that verifies the auto-downgrade rate metric is emitted to the run summary so it can be observed post-deploy.
- [Reliability] Reviewer oscillation detection (from scope extension note): when the same file accumulates ≥ N auto-downgraded NEW_INTRODUCED findings across cycles, emit a structured REVIEWER_OSCILLATION_DETECTED event. This scope extension is optional for this story but should be evaluated by implementation-plan as a potential addendum (low incremental cost given relation extraction is already present).
